intent: RDG 上方建立一等 feature、typed recipe、单源资源需求与贯通 prepare/build/publication 的同一份 resolved composition；不以 Bloom 算法为目标

status_rules.in_progress: 已有部分实现或验证，尚未满足完整 expected
status_rules.blocked: 必须记录具体原因、现有证据与解除条件
status_rules.verified: 完整 expected 有本次可复现测试/runtime/performance 证据；历史记录不能代替
status_rules.editing: 默认仅更新 status/evidence；改变 expected/checkpoints 必须先复审并记入 progress

rows.expected: concept/add 存储至少两类真实异构 feature；typed ports 连接输入输出；公开 API 无 feature 枚举 switch、std::any 或字符串 blackboard

rows.area: single resolve and explicit prepared frame
rows.expected: prepareFrameRecord 返回本次准备值，record 显式消费；同 invocation resolve 一次；新设置请求只影响下一次，资源要求与构图参数一致
SSAO off 无 AO requirement/专属 upload/DS/pass/新 AO publication；Lighting OptionalAO absent 使用明确中性语义；删除 bUseSSAO 逐层透传

rows.area: resource requirement is executable source of truth
rows.expected: 同一声明生成 allocation request 和 graph import 描述；format/usage 同步；request 按 role 规范化，声明重排不改变 allocation；graph-use metadata 不进入 equality

rows.area: typed connections and preparation token validation
rows.expected: 拒绝缺 required input、串 composition 端口、role 冲突、错 tick/pipeline token；类型不兼容在编译期暴露；optional absence 合法

rows.area: resource identity independent of recipe position
rows.expected: feature 插入、View 增减不改变既有 import key；同 label 不同 scope 独立；同资源消费者借同一 lowered slot 不重复 import

rows.area: invocation storage and CPU callback lifetime
rows.expected: resolved/prepared storage move 和扩容后端口与 bindings 正确；callback 不引用 builder/临时局部变量；CPU record 生命周期不被误当 GPU 保活
双 View SSAO settings/payload/upload/DS/output 独立，B 不覆盖 A；共享 frame/skinning input 不被机械复制
Bloom 等多 pass contribution 每次更新需要独立 descriptor；归一化 pass 次数在 invocation 内；persistent/transient 来源固定；无共享 last-call 状态

rows.area: failure does not publish stale or partial family
rows.expected: 安全点开始本 tick publication，safe preparation 错误后查询为空；binding/build/compile/execute 不以旧图或部分新图发布本次 family；成功诊断不包含失败执行；合法空 workload 不是失败
ColorStream 同 backing 续写保留 Load/Store/深度读写和 sample hazard；Deferred Overlay 在颜色效果后且当前 Bloom.Composite backing 被 Overlay 续写，诊断输出为 Overlay 后内容（与旧行为一致）；Forward 保留既有插入位置
grading/Bloom off 仍产生合法 DisplayColor；编码及 display compose 不变；缺 Finalize 不被兼容 fallback 吞掉
只发布本次 declared 且有效输出；allocated-but-skipped 不发布；统一 role collector，不在两个 pipeline 解析 feature export 名；现有 consumers 兼容

rows.area: private feature resource change is local
rows.expected: 多 pass feature 增加私有 scratch / 修改局部资源描述，通过同一 contract 路径工作，无 pipeline、executor、registry、集中 slot 修改
Deferred 全功能连接由一个 recipe 可读；无 legacy prelude/tail、all-stage context、graph resources bag、集中 bindings 分配；旧 draw/gating/picking/debug 行为一致
Forward 全功能连接由一个 recipe 可读；共享 feature 通过同一协议；旧 orchestrator/context/bag 退出；不顺带补 transparent/Sprite 功能

rows.area: shared inputs and current lighting contract
rows.expected: 真实 shared GPU inputs 明确并准备一次；最新 local-light generated 类型/字段映射/预算用例保留；feature-specific payload/layout/binding 不再进入 shared bag

rows.area: Shadow participates without changing owner or algorithm
rows.expected: Shadow typed token 经 composition 接入两 recipe，无旁路子 executor；strategy 持 images/runtime；invocation face/cascade/cull bindings 独立；View/Scene 不串
resize/switch/reload/unregister 保留 reuse、generation、lease、fence；empty/UI-only/no surface/no extent 合法；失败或 absence 无跨 flight 旧图兜底
调用状态/原因、typed connections、owner、pass 贡献、有效 outputs 可与 actual graph 核对；owning diagnostic strings 不悬空；trace off 不收重型文本
测试专用 producer→multi-pass transform→consumer 经 request/prepare/lower/append/publish 完整运行，只需 feature 与 recipe 接线；无 core/context/bindings bag 改动

rows.area: runtime multiple Views on both strategies
rows.expected: 真实 backend 两 pipeline 多 View 实跑，参数/DS/attachments/publication 各自独立；不能仅用同 label scope 单测代替
verification: integration fixture or editor multi-view evidence

rows.area: performance, GPU churn and final closure
rows.expected: 同环境至少 3 次 CPU/GPU/内存前后对照、低负载 prepare/build 对照；无稳态 GPU allocation/import replacement regression；全部 bridge/旧横向链退出；稳定规则吸收
